policy: No idea advances to decision-grade ranking without: (1) fresh current-law check within 90 days, (2) competitor search, (3) official/free-tool substitute check, (4) named buyer identification, (5) one falsifiable experiment result with pre-registered kill criteria.
frozenDisplayNote: All 294 items in this ranking carry rankingMaturity=legacy_unverified. Scores were generated by LLM models without external market or competitor validation. They represent research hypotheses, not decision-grade evaluations.
rankingEligibilityRule: rankingEligible=false for all items until maturity reaches DESK_RESEARCHED_CURRENT minimum
resetReason: VenturaAtlas accumulated 294 canonical ideas with 0 active experiments. The last successful validation explicitly did not validate market/evidence truth. The reset removes confidence before removing evidence.

restorationConditions.individual: An idea may exit FROZEN_PENDING_REVALIDATION when it reaches DESK_RESEARCHED_CURRENT maturity with a passed falsifiable experiment
restorationConditions.universe: The reset is considered closed when at least 5 ideas have reached EXPERIMENT_EXECUTED maturity and 1 has reached PAID_PILOT
